_rule: KV writes are reserved for live matches (owner ruling 2026-10-08; see the proxy repo's docs/decisions.md entry). The 1,000/day KV write cap is ACCOUNT-WIDE and shared with the proxy; this worker's MATCH_STATE writes ARE the live-match budget the rule protects. A NEW write here must be `live-match`, or an `owner-exception` approved in advance; `legacy` = pre-rule, inventoried, must not grow. Guard: test/kv-write-guard.test.ts (file + enclosing function + key expression + count).
_measured: Owner, Cloudflare KV Metrics (2026-10-09, last 30 days): MATCH_STATE 120-200+ writes on a 2-4-match day; est. 300-400+ on an 8-match Decision Day.
